title: Three Sheets Liquor Backlot Stash ($2,288+)
description: After delivering Salty Squid rum to Shirley, climb the side alley fence behind Three Sheets Liquor. Talk to the parrot for the generator clue ($1,354 cash) and crack the storage room safe ($934 cash + key valuable).

title: Grassrivers Smuggler Plane Crash ($1,200 Coke)
description: Triggered while crossing the Keys bridge; follow the black smoke into Grassrivers wetlands to loot $1,200 in cocaine and a flare gun before the Kingfishers gang arrives.

title: Manatee Motel Tiger Lair (Laird 350 Sniper & $2,200+)
description: Clear the tiger and incoming Kingfishers gang at Manatee Motel near Grassrivers. Loot $462 table cash, $971 from the safe, $800 in cocaine, and the Kingfishers Laird 350 Sniper in the adjacent room.

title: Hamlet Warehouse (Hobo Shotgun & Collectible Card)
description: Follow the screams into the Hamlet warehouse in South Vice-Dale and take out the gang inside to grab the unique Marabunta Grande Hobo Shotgun, $368 cash, and the Javier Gomez Collectible Card behind the left shelves.

title: Apollo Aggregate Red Warehouse ($6,400+ Motherlode)
description: Combat-free early-game jackpot north of Hamlet with dead gang members inside. Loot cocaine from the indoor/outdoor vans and teddy-bear rooms, plus $400 cash and the Leroy Rook (Silver) Collectible Card from the office safe.

title: Key Lento Ammu-Nation Free SM-69 Sniper
description: Exiting the Key Lento Ammu-Nation frequently triggers hostile thugs outside; defeat them bare-handed and loot a free SM-69 Sniper Rifle from the bed of their pickup truck.

title: Brian's Warehouse (Sell Stolen Goods & Cocaine)
description: Fence drop-off location in Key Lento where you can sell cocaine stash bags, jewelry, and marked bills collected from early-game farming spots for instant cash.
